questions.stem: Why do you feel pain AFTER you have already pulled your hand away from a hot object?

options.text: Because the motor neurone sends signals back to the brain
Because the reflex bypasses the brain, so conscious awareness comes later
Because pain receptors are slow to respond
Because pain is caused by the muscle contracting

questions.explanation: The reflex arc passes through the spinal cord, not the brain, so the hand moves before you consciously feel pain. A separate signal is sent to the brain, which is why pain is felt after the reflex response.
